About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Networking Monitoring to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you will lead the team that tells us, in real time, whether the network is healthy and doing what we intended. You own fabric telemetry, alerting, health checks and drift detection across every site, and the team that builds them.

Today we often learn about network problems late: from a failed job, a customer ticket or an engineer chasing a hunch. Telemetry covers only part of the fleet, device lists are kept by hand, and nothing routinely checks that devices match what we intended.

The opportunity is to make the network observable end to end: every device monitored from the moment it exists, alerts that point to the cause, and checks that catch drift before customers feel it. As our GPU fabrics scale, this visibility becomes what keeps them reliable.

What You’ll Do

  • Hire, lead and grow a team of software engineers building internal network tools.

  • Own the tooling roadmap: inventory, IPAM, cabling and build planning, CLIs, portals and integrations.

  • Treat network engineers as customers: gather needs, prioritize, and measure adoption and time saved.

  • Keep the source of truth accurate through validation, reconciliation and clear ownership of data.

  • Integrate tools with automation, monitoring, ticketing and identity systems.

  • Set standards for usability, reliability, access control and documentation.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineering teams.

  • Experience building internal platforms or developer tools used by engineering or operations teams.

  • Working knowledge of data center networking and tools such as NetBox or other IPAM and DCIM systems.

  • Enough hands-on Go, Python or TypeScript to review designs and code credibly.

  • A product mindset: you ship what users adopt, not just what is asked for.

  • Experience hiring and building a team from early stage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a large scale cloud, data center or telecom environment.

  • Background in UX or product management for technical users.

Why this Role Matters

  • Customers run large AI training jobs where a degraded network means lost GPU hours.

  • As the fleet grows, problems must be caught by systems, not by people chasing symptoms.

  • Monitoring closes the loop on automation: it proves changes worked and catches drift early.

  • You will build this function from the ground up and define how we measure network reliability.

What We Offer

  • Stock Options

  • 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees

  • Company Health Savings Account Contributions

  • 100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees

  • Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options

  • Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance

  • Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support

  • Flexible Spending Account

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid Holidays

  • Parental Leave

  • Other In-Office Perks

Equal Employment Opportunity

TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodations

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

Employment Eligibility

All offers of employment are contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by law.

Background Checks

Where permitted by law, employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of a job-related background check.

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.
